minutes.headline: Committee approved the Town Offices/school building layout with changes, then agreed parking guidance; tight schedule threatens Special Town Meeting.
minutes.summary: The TCP Building Design Committee reviewed the architect's revised plan for a new building (about 58,000 sq ft), suggested small layout tweaks, and voted by roll call to approve the layout with those modifications. It then worked out site and parking direction for the civil engineers by consensus after a motion on parking was withdrawn. Members discussed the schedule: estimate timing runs up against the deadline for a Special Town Meeting, and public outreach was deferred.

votes.motion: Approve the design layout as presented with the discussed modifications.
votes.outcome: passed 5-0 (roll call: Pacios, Jeffries, Blatt, Leighton, Christina and the chair aye as heard)

votes.motion: Adopt the red parking layout, removing front island spaces and adding them on the access road behind the wing.
Motion on parking withdrawn after consensus on guidance to the architect.

budget_items.what_was_said: A member said the article is only for funding of construction documents, and the Finance Committee would consider that amount.
The architect's thoughtful estimate is being sought rather than a simple square-foot multiplication.
figures_as_heard: three hundred dollars a square foot

budget_items.what_was_said: The architect said total parking cost would be about the same wherever it is placed.
The contract was said to be for 60 days, with a deadline for special town meeting.

decisions.decision: Parking guidance: slide the parking bay and building back about 15-20 feet, add roughly 20-30 spaces on the left side, remove the 15 front island spaces and the spaces near the island; chair to email sketch to architect.
Remove kitchen door to the primary meeting room, add corridor doors, and plan a range hood; kitchen to be infrastructure only.
Public forum date deferred until the architect gives a firmer schedule; likely second week of November, one week before town meeting.
Approval of prior minutes pushed to next week.
Meetings continue every Wednesday in October at 5:30 by Zoom; November schedule to be set next week.

what_happened.line: The committee voted 5-0 by roll call to approve the building layout with the discussed modifications.
A motion on the parking layout was withdrawn after members reached consensus on guidance to the architect.
The parking guidance moves the bay and building back, adds spaces on the left side and removes the front island spaces.
Members found the design schedule runs up against the deadline for a Special Town Meeting, and no resolution was reached.
The public forum date was deferred until the architect gives a firmer schedule, likely about a week before town meeting.

why_it_matters: The layout now fixed for the shared Town Offices and school building sets what the architect prices, and that price is what residents will be asked to fund at a Special Town Meeting.
With the public forum not yet scheduled and the timeline tight, residents may have little time to weigh in before they are asked to vote.
